BiblicalUsage: The possessor appears once, in Acts 4:34: "as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold." The early church's owners became its givers, and no one among them lacked.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that this verse shows what ownership looks like when the gospel takes hold: what I possess becomes what the church needs, and nobody goes without.
